COMPETITION TRIBUNAL REPUBLIC OF SOUTH AFRICA

Case No.: LM015Apr25

ORDER

Further to the recommendation of the Competition Commission in terms of section 14A(1)(b)(ii) of the Competition Act, 1998 ("the Act") the Competition Tribunal orders that the merger between the abovementioned parties be approved subject to the conditions set out in Annexure A and Annexure B in terms of section 16(2)(b) of the Act, and that a Merger Clearance Certificate be issued in terms of Competition Tribunal Rule 35(5)(a).

Merger Clearance Certificate

You applied to the Competition Commission on 23 April 2025 for merger approval in accordance with Chapter 3 of the Competition Act.

After reviewing all relevant information, and the recommendation or decision of the Competition Commission, the Competition Tribunal approves the merger in terms of section 16(2) of the Act, for the reasons set out in the Reasons for Decision.
